description.zh: 发送前自动压缩旧的工具结果和长消息、按批次截断过长历史（照顾缓存命中）、让自动总结更短更省、可选精简工具说明和简洁回答规则；另带清理测试/一次性对话、长对话接力到新对话的工具。聊天记录本身不会被修改。
description.en: Compacts old tool output and long messages before sending, trims long histories in cache-friendly batches, makes auto-summary shorter, optionally slims tool descriptions and adds terse-answer rules; plus tools to clean throwaway chats and hand long chats off to new ones. Stored chat records are never modified.

description.zh: 查看/调整精简模式、清理一次性对话、接力新对话、调整自动总结阈值
description.en: Lean mode settings, throwaway-chat cleanup, chat hand-off, auto-summary tuning
